archmage.solo_only: Prototype is single-player only; close LAN first.
archmage.missing_dimension: Mind Palace dimension is unavailable. Check the mod and use a new test world.
archmage.palace_enter: Mind Palace: right-click the central amethyst with an empty hand. Fallback: /archmage learn_test. M to return.
archmage.test_start: Quas unlocked; frost echo granted. Press M to visit the altar.
archmage.learned: Test frost pulse learned permanently and equipped in slot 1. Leave and press R.
archmage.need_essence: Quas and a frost echo are required. Run /archmage test_start.
archmage.cast_outside: Cast the combat test outside the Palace.
archmage.not_learned: Press M and right-click the central altar. Inside fallback: /archmage learn_test.
archmage.look_on: Archmage appearance enabled. F5 to view; V for your normal skin.
archmage.look_off: Normal skin restored. V for archmage appearance.
archmage.altar_label:
MEMORY ALTAR
Empty-hand right-click: learn pulse
Return with M → cast with R
archmage.learn_inside: Learn spells inside the Mind Palace. Press M.
archmage.already_learned: Pulse is already learned and equipped. M to leave; R to cast near mobs.
